name: scala-cqrs-es

options.generatorVersion: string — host generator id stamped into the '@generated by CodegenMain:' header line (date fallback when omitted; mirrors internal GeneratorVersion and never participates in comparisons)
options.elementHashes: object — knowledge-side sidecar { noteId: hash16 } (a slice of the graph export's elementHashes); drives the `@knowledge <uuid>@<hash>` anchor suffix. Missing entry → bare `@knowledge <uuid>` (mirrors internal getOrElse "").
options.relics: object — corpus-fact skip list { skipValueObjects: [names] }: value objects whose live file predates their truth-source declaration and was never rewritten by the incremental gate (handwritten, not engine output). Omit on a fresh tree — every voCatalog entry emits.

description: Reference generator: Akka CQRS/Event-Sourced aggregate skeletons (protocol/root/entity/event-handler/repository/factory/behaviors/command-helpers) ported from the production CodegenMain pipeline, byte-identical to live output; also emits the shared value-object, persistence-contract proto, and Event/SnapshotAdapter+ProtoConverters faces (V4-16/V4-17).
